# Card

The workspace's structural module — diagnostic artifacts, connector rows, metric panels.

`SuDuAI.Card` · Surfaces

## Use

```jsx
<SuDuAI.Card>…</SuDuAI.Card>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SuDuAI.Card">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Glass data container with an optional icon/title/subtitle header and action slot.

## Props (CardProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` | Bold label-lg header title. |
| `subtitle` | `React.ReactNode` | Muted body-sm line under the title. |
| `icon` | `string` | Material Symbols glyph shown in a raised 8px tile before the title. |
| `actions` | `React.ReactNode` | Right-aligned header content — badges, status pills, icon buttons. |
| `level` | `1 \| 2 \| 3` | Elevation layer: 1 = module shell, 2 = floating overlay, 3 = active focus / command hub. |
| `interactive` | `boolean` | Enables the hover lift and neon border shift. |
| `padding` | `string` | Override the default --space-lg padding. |
